turns.question: How many customers placed more than three orders between 17 August and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: it cannot count customers by how many orders each one placed, so I cannot give a figure for customers with more than three orders between 17 August and 2 October 2026. The closest metrics are Active customers (distinct customers with at least one non-cancelled order), Repeat customers (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order in the period who have placed two or more orders in all) and Orders (all orders placed, cancelled included); I can give any of these for that period if you want.
